description: Give a user an individual role on the project or a form (separately from groups). THE ROLES AND WHAT THEY MEAN (as a person sees them in the interface): owner = «Admin» — full access, like the owner's, rights and structure included; member = «Read only»; writer = «Read and write»; writer_not_delete = «Read and write without delete»; read_edit_delete = «Read, edit, delete»; read_and_edit = «Read and edit»; creator = «Read, write, create forms». When the person says «make her an admin», that is owner.

entity_id.description: Optional — limit the role to a particular form

role.description: owner | member | writer | creator | writer_not_delete | read_edit_delete | read_and_edit

name: set_user_role
